def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().lower()
    c = Counter(re.findall(rb"[a-z]+", data))
    top = sorted(c.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))[:10]
    sys.stdout.write("".join(f"{w.decode()} {n}\n" for w, n in top))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
